body:
Every primary school child should learn at least one traditional song or dance from their own country.

To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Readers who only ever read books written in their own language miss out on some of the most original fiction written anywhere in the world.

To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Governments should give money to their own film industries, even when the films they produce are unlikely to attract large audiences.

Do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Museums in wealthy countries should return historical artefacts to the nations where they were made, even when those objects are among their most popular exhibits.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Some people think that street art and graffiti make city walls more colourful and interesting. Others believe that they are simply vandalism, and that they make neighbourhoods look neglected.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Some people believe that schools should concentrate on the history of the child's own country. Others argue that pupils benefit more from learning about the histories of other regions of the world.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

While some people prefer foreign films to be dubbed into their own language so that they can concentrate on the pictures, others feel that subtitles keep the original performances intact.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Some people think that traditional festivals should be promoted to tourists, because the money they bring helps to keep local customs alive. Others believe that once a festival is designed mainly for visitors, its meaning is lost.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Apprentices in skilled crafts such as glassblowing, silversmithing and furniture making are often paid very little during a training period that can last five years or more.

What problems does this cause?

What can be done to make this kind of training affordable for young people?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Public libraries in many areas have cut their opening hours or closed branches in recent years, even though large numbers of people still use them.

Why is this happening?

What measures could local governments take to keep libraries open?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Traditional dishes from many countries are now sold around the world in versions so changed by food manufacturers that they bear little resemblance to the originals.

What problems does this cause for the countries these dishes come from?

What can be done to protect the reputation of traditional national dishes?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Large companies increasingly form project teams whose members live in different countries, work in different time zones and communicate mainly through video calls and messages.

Do you think the advantages of working in multinational teams outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

A growing number of universities in non-English-speaking countries now teach whole degree courses in English in order to attract students and lecturers from abroad.

Do you think the advantages of teaching degree courses in English outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

National museums now lend famous paintings and sculptures to galleries in other countries for temporary exhibitions that can last several months.

Do the advantages of this practice outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Owners of shop premises in city centres increasingly prefer to rent to international chains, which can pay higher rents and sign longer leases than independent local traders.

Is this a positive or negative development?

Should local councils be allowed to set aside some shop units for independent businesses at reduced rents?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Some countries provide free music lessons to every child in state schools, whereas in others music is taught only to pupils who show exceptional talent.

Why do some governments give music a low priority in the school curriculum?

To what extent do music lessons in childhood benefit people who never become musicians?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Many historic buildings are now repaired with modern materials such as concrete and plastic, because the traditional techniques for using lime and timber are no longer widely known.

Why are traditional building techniques becoming less common?

Should the owners of listed buildings be required to use traditional materials, even when this is much more expensive?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
